name: Project Review - Gate Refused
description: The status page's gate refusing a wrong passphrase, with none of the internal roadmap disclosed behind it. The only in-page failure state this view has, since nothing here fetches anything at runtime. It is worth capturing rather than assuming because the refusal path is where a gate silently fails open: this page hand-rolls its own gate, exactly as the supporter-recognition deck does, because a raw public/ file is copied verbatim into dist/ and no Astro component ever renders it.
